title: Project bordiar ss
script:
-- =====================================
-- Project bor_diar ss
-- Rayfield Edition (ARRUMADO)
-- =====================================

repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Project bor_diar ss",
    LoadingTitle = "bor_diar ss",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Rayfield Edition",
    ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
    Discord = { Enabled = false },
    KeySystem = false
})

-- Abas
local MainTab  = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
local ChaosTab = Window:CreateTab("Chaos", 4483362458)
local AdminTab = Window:CreateTab("Admin", 4483362458)

-- Função botão seguro
local function AddScriptButton(tab, name, url)
    local executed = false

    tab:CreateButton({
        Name = name,
        Callback = function()
            if executed then
                Rayfield:Notify({
                    Title = "bor_diar ss",
                    Content = name .. " já está ativo",
                    Duration = 3
                })
                return
            end

            executed = true
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                loadstring(game:HttpGet(url))()
            end)

            if not ok then
                Rayfield:Notify({
                    Title = "Erro",
                    Content = tostring(err),
                    Duration = 5
                })
            end
        end
    })
end

-- ======================
-- MAIN
-- ======================
AddScriptButton(MainTab, "CADUCUS", "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ian49972/SCRIPTS/refs/heads/main/CADUCUS%20(FIXED)")
